conbody.p: When Smart Cruise Control and Lane Following Assist are both active, Emergency Stop becomes operational.

li.p: Even if the Forward Attention Warning function is deactivated, the system will monitor the driver’s attention when preparing for Emergency Stop. For detailed information on the driver monitoring system, refer to .
If the Forward Attention Warning is equipped and Forward Attention Warning is turned off or a malfunction occurs with the interior camera, Lane Following Assist cannot be activated.
If the driver unfastens the seat belt, while driving at 20 km/h (13 mph) or higher, Lane Following Assist will turn off.
Lane Following Assist cannot be activated if the driver is not wearing a seat belt.
